apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Some features rely on external services that require a personal key. Keys are stored in the system keychain, never in a file.

acoustid.name: AcoustID
acoustid.why: Identifies a track by its acoustic fingerprint (the audio itself, not its name). This is what finds the right studio version of a song and automatically fills in album, year, track number and cover art. Free key at acoustid.org.

rateLimits.title: API rate limits
rateLimits.description: Controls how cautious the app is when calling external services. Every service has its own rules: staying polite is what keeps you from getting blocked.

download.name: Delay between two downloads
download.why: On a playlist, the app downloads tracks one by one from YouTube. Back-to-back requests from the same IP are exactly what triggers throttling: a pause between tracks makes the batch look like normal listening. The real delay is randomised between this value and twice it.
download.estimate: For a {{count}}-track playlist, the pauses add about {{duration}}.
download.warning: Below 3 seconds, the risk of being rate-limited (403 errors) rises sharply on long playlists.

acoustid.name: Delay between AcoustID requests
acoustid.why: Every imported track is identified by its acoustic fingerprint through AcoustID. The service allows 3 requests per second per key, and an album runs its lookups back to back — hence this pause.
acoustid.estimate: For a {{count}}-track album, the pauses add about {{duration}}.
acoustid.warning: Below 0.34s you exceed the documented 3 requests/second limit and the key may get throttled.

lastfm.name: Delay between Last.fm requests
lastfm.why: When a track has no MusicBrainz genre at all, the "Recompute genres" action queries Last.fm to find one. That API key is shared by every beets user in the world: a delay between requests keeps it from getting temporarily blocked for everyone.
lastfm.estimate: For {{count}} genre-less tracks at this pace: about {{duration}}.
lastfm.warning: Below one second isn't recommended: stay polite to Last.fm and avoid hitting it with too many requests too close together.

developer.title: Developer tools
developer.description: Only visible in development builds. These tools are destructive and meant for testing the app, not using it.

resetLibrary.name: Reset the library
resetLibrary.why: Deletes every audio file in the library and the beets database, for a clean slate between test runs.
resetLibrary.warning: Every library file and the beets index will be permanently deleted.
